de.abas.erp.db.util

Class FieldMap<S extends FieldValueProvider,D extends FieldValueSetter>

  • Object
    • FieldMap<S,D>
  • Type Parameters:
    S - Source type
    D - Destination type

    public final class FieldMap<S extends FieldValueProvider,D extends FieldValueSetter>
extends Object
    A mapping of a set of fields of a source type to a set of fields of a destination type. Data transfer between fields is faster in some situations (for the moment: when both instances are backed by FO) as simply use getter and setter methods to transfer the field values.
    Author:
    mm

      • assign

        public <ES extends S,ED extends D> void assign(ES source,
                                               ED dest)
        Executes a mapping for two given instances of the source and destination type or types that inherit from them.
        Type Parameters:
        ES - Source type. May be a subclass of S.
        ED - Destination type. May be a subclass of D.
        Parameters:
        source - The source instance where the field values are copied from.
        dest - The destination instance where the field value are copied to.
        Throws:
        FieldAccessException - if a field is not accessible
        FieldValueException - if a value is not valid for the specified destination field
